# edgecenter_websec_location (Resource)

WebSec location: a rule of an `edgecenter_websec_resource` for the requests whose path matches `location`. These requests can go to their own source group and get their own protection options. `name` and `location` are unique within the resource. The API refuses to create, change or delete the locations of a resource that the administrator has disabled (its `enabled` is `false`).

Changing `resource_id` replaces the location; every other attribute is updated in place.

Import with `<resource_id>:<location_id>`. `GET <edgecenter_websec_api>/resources/<resource_id>/locations` lists the locations of a resource with their ids, and `edgecenter_websec_api` defaults to `<api_endpoint>/v2/protection`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "edgecenter" {
  permanent_api_token = "251$d3361.............1b35f26d8"
}

resource "edgecenter_websec_source_group" "example_com" {
  name = "example.com origins"

  source {
    source = "203.0.113.10"
  }

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

resource "edgecenter_websec_source_group" "example_com_api" {
  name = "example.com api origins"

  source {
    source = "203.0.113.20"
  }

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

resource "edgecenter_websec_resource" "example_com" {
  domain       = "example.com"
  source_group = edgecenter_websec_source_group.example_com.id

  options {
    tls_versions {
      value = ["TLSv1.2", "TLSv1.3"]
    }
  }
}

resource "edgecenter_websec_location" "example_com_api" {
  resource_id  = edgecenter_websec_resource.example_com.id
  name         = "api"
  location     = "^/api/"
  weight       = 10
  source_group = edgecenter_websec_source_group.example_com_api.id

  options {
    allowed_http_methods {
      value = ["GET", "POST"]
    }

    asn_acl {
      policy_type     = "allow"
      excepted_values = [64496, 64511]
    }

    antibot_flood_challenge {
      value = "ANTIBOT_CHALLENGE_JS"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String) Regular expression for the request path that triggers the location. It starts with "/" or "^/", holds more than slashes, has no whitespace, quotes or semicolons and is up to 255 characters. The API also checks that it is a valid PCRE pattern. Unique within the resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the location, up to 255 characters, unique within the resource.
- `resource_id` (Number) ID of the `edgecenter_websec_resource` the location belongs to. Changing it replaces the location.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Enable or disable the location. Defaults to `true`.
- `options` (Block List, Max: 1) Protection options of the location. The location is created with exactly the options set here, so no API defaults apply. An update sends only the options that changed, and removing an option block deletes the option. An empty `options {}` block is rejected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options))
- `source_group` (Number) ID of the `edgecenter_websec_source_group` the requests of the location go to. Without it they go to the source group of the resource.
- `weight` (Number) Weight of the location, from 1 to 2147483647. Defaults to `1`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options`

Optional:

- `allowed_http_methods` (Block List, Max: 1) HTTP methods allowed in requests. The methods you can use are set per client and resource, by default "GET", "HEAD", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE" and "OPTIONS". (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--allowed_http_methods))
- `antibot_flood_challenge` (Block List, Max: 1) Check that a request comes from a browser before passing it on. The check answers with HTTP 307 and sets the antibot cookie. Disabling it on a resource also disables the antibot URL exceptions and user agent whitelist of the resource, which this provider does not manage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--antibot_flood_challenge))
- `asn_acl` (Block List, Max: 1) Allow or deny requests by the autonomous system number of the client. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--asn_acl))
- `referer_acl` (Block List, Max: 1) Allow or deny requests by the Referer header. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--referer_acl))
- `user_agent_acl` (Block List, Max: 1) Allow or deny requests by the User-Agent header. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--user_agent_acl))

<a id="nestedblock--options--allowed_http_methods"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.allowed_http_methods`

Required:

- `value` (Set of String) Allowed HTTP methods.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the option. Defaults to `true`.


<a id="nestedblock--options--antibot_flood_challenge"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.antibot_flood_challenge`

Optional:

- `antibot_challenge_get_only_on` (Boolean) Apply the antibot cookie to GET requests only. Defaults to `false`.
- `antibot_challenge_timelimit` (Number) Lifetime of the antibot cookie in minutes. Defaults to `10`.
- `antibot_challenge_utm_referrer` (Boolean) Keep the UTM parameters of the original request through the challenge redirect. Defaults to `false`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the option. Defaults to `true`.
- `value` (String) Check type: "ANTIBOT_CHALLENGE" checks the browser request, "ANTIBOT_CHALLENGE_JS" checks it with a JavaScript file, "ANTIBOT_CHALLENGE_JS_BOX" needs a human interaction. Required when the option is enabled.


<a id="nestedblock--options--asn_acl"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.asn_acl`

Required:

- `excepted_values` (Set of Number) ASNs that are the exceptions from `policy_type`, from 1 to 2147483647. Private 4-byte ASNs above 2147483647 cannot be set.
- `policy_type` (String) Default policy, "allow" or "deny". Requests that match `excepted_values` get the opposite one.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the option. Defaults to `true`.


<a id="nestedblock--options--referer_acl"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.referer_acl`

Required:

- `excepted_values` (Set of String) Domains, "*.domain" or "domain.*" patterns in lowercase that are the exceptions from `policy_type`. An empty string stands for requests without the Referer header and needs at least one more value.
- `policy_type` (String) Default policy, "allow" or "deny". Requests that match `excepted_values` get the opposite one.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the option. Defaults to `true`.


<a id="nestedblock--options--user_agent_acl"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.user_agent_acl`

Required:

- `excepted_values` (Set of String) User agents that are the exceptions from `policy_type`. A value that starts with "~" is a regular expression.
- `policy_type` (String) Default policy, "allow" or "deny". Requests that match `excepted_values` get the opposite one.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the option. Defaults to `true`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import edgecenter_websec_location.example_com_api 12345:67
```
